# aether_cost_breakdown (Data Source)

Month-to-date cost breakdown of the organization, for the current UTC month only (the API offers no other period). `autoscaling` mixes two kinds of line: per node pool, one line per resource type (`vcpu`, `memory`, `disk`) with the pool's `node_pool_id` and name; and storage lines (`registry`, `storage_block`, `storage_rwx`, in GiB-hours) whose `node_pool_id` is null and whose `pool_name` holds a CLUSTER name (or a label such as `(deleted cluster)`), not a pool. The `registry` line is where registry storage consumption appears.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `autoscaling` (Attributes List) Usage lines: per-pool resource lines followed by storage lines (see the data source description). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling))
- `period_end` (String) First instant of the next UTC month (RFC 3339).
- `period_start` (String) First instant of the current UTC month (RFC 3339).
- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) Flat monthly charges of the month (fixed pools, control plane, packages, public endpoints, load balancers). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))
- `subtotal_eur` (Number) Month-to-date total in euros (subscriptions plus usage lines).

<a id="nestedatt--autoscaling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autoscaling`

Read-Only:

- `amount_eur` (Number) Line cost in euros.
- `node_pool_id` (String) Node pool UUID; null for storage lines and deleted pools.
- `pool_name` (String) Node pool name for pool lines; the CLUSTER name (or a label) for storage lines.
- `quantity` (Number) Quantity consumed this month.
- `resource_type` (String) `vcpu`, `memory` or `disk` for pool lines; `registry`, `storage_block` or `storage_rwx` for storage lines. Not an enum: other values may appear.
- `unit` (String) Unit of `quantity` (e.g. `gib-hour`).
- `unit_price_eur` (Number) Price per unit in euros.


<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `amount_eur` (Number) Net amount in euros (`gross_amount_eur - discount_eur`).
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster UUID; null when the line is not cluster-scoped.
- `discount_eur` (Number) Discount in euros.
- `gross_amount_eur` (Number) Amount before discount, in euros.
- `kind` (String) Which flat monthly charge this line is.
- `name` (String) Display name of the charged item.
- `node_pool_id` (String) Node pool UUID; null when the line is not pool-scoped.
